snippet.title: Video Dev Blog: Powering Your Buildings | Ashes of the Singularity II
snippet.description:
In this developer journal for Ashes of the Singularity II, BATTLEMODE shows the changes to the Building Construction system and the new Power mechanic. Many Buildings can be constructed in a single Region now, limited by the Power in the region.

Wishlist Ashes of the Singularity 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499790/Ashes_of_the_Singularity_II/
